description: This file defines the class Zend_Validate_Hostname, which provides validation logic for hostnames, including support for IDNs, TLD validation, IP addresses, and local hostnames. It includes methods for configuration, validation, and decoding punycode hostnames.

classes.name: Zend_Validate_Hostname
classes.description: A validator class for hostnames, supporting various hostname formats, TLDs, IDNs, and options for allowed hostname types.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the validator with options for allowed hostname types, IDN validation, TLD validation, and IP validation.

methods.name: setOptions
methods.description: Sets multiple options such as allow types, IDN validation, TLD validation, and IP validator.

methods.name: getIpValidator
methods.description: Retrieves the current IP validator instance.

methods.name: setIpValidator
methods.description: Sets or initializes the IP validator used for IP address validation.

methods.name: getAllow
methods.description: Returns the current allow configuration bitmask.

methods.name: setAllow
methods.description: Sets the allow configuration bitmask for hostname validation.

methods.name: getValidateIdn
methods.description: Checks if IDN validation is enabled.

methods.name: getValidateTld
methods.description: Checks if TLD validation is active.

methods.name: isValid
methods.description: Performs hostname validation based on the current configuration, including checks for IP addresses, DNS hostnames, and local network names.

methods.name: decodePunycode
methods.description: Decodes a Punycode-encoded string to its UTF-8 representation, used for internationalized domain names.
